Com o jogo em foco: F6 Castle Hallway, F: With the game focused: F6 Castle Hallway, F7 battle, F9 Mothman. Measure about 30 seconds per scenario; F10 ends collection. Close the game to generate the ZIP. Limit: 18,000 samples.
Mede intervalos e tempos do host. Não me: Measures callback intervals and host timings, not CPU/GPU utilization or GPU execution time. Keep image captures disabled.
CAPTURAS EXPERIMENTAIS: CENÁRIO, SPRITES: EXPERIMENTAL CAPTURES: SCENERY, SPRITES AND SHADERS
Desenho real: pressione F8 em uma cena p: Real draw: press F8 in a stationary scene; collection may pause for a few seconds. Shaders: automatic collection, no F8. For sprites, press F8 while moving a character. Choose before launching the game.
Com o jogo aberto, pressione F8 ou cliqu: With the game running, press F8 or click Capture frame. Up to eight captures per session. Saving may briefly pause the game.
Em Shaders — preparar Vulkan, a coleta é: In Shaders — prepare Vulkan, collection is automatic during gameplay, without F8. Visit menus, Castle Hallway and a battle, then close the game to receive the ZIP in Downloads. This mode does not capture images.
Nas cenas reconhecidas, o relatório incl: In recognized scenes, the report includes the scene without HUD, isolated HUD, recomposition and pixel comparison. Normal game rendering remains the reference.
Ao fechar o jogo, um ZIP será salvo em D: Closing the game saves a ZIP in Downloads. Original files also remain in the capture folder.
